8.2 Key-Value Storage
This section lists all functions and classes that are required to operate a
Key-Value
Storage
.
The following functions are used to get access to a
Key-Value Storage
, to recover
as much as possible after it was corrupted, to reset it to the deployed defaults, and to
get the amount of storage space allocated to the
Key-Value Storage
.
